sentences.text: Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he has a six-month review of his care package.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he currently receives Brightpath Home Care four times a day (morning, dinner, tea, and bed).
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he cannot do the buttons on his clothes any more due to his hands.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he does not go up the stairs and sleeps downstairs.
Karen Walsh (S3) stated the bed was brought down in March after a fall.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he uses a frame around the house most of the time when he remembers.
Karen Walsh (S3) stated carers do microwave meals at dinner and tea, and she brings a proper dinner round on a Sunday.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated carers prompt his diabetes tablets in the morning and at night.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated there is one carer, Lee, who does the mornings most mornings.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he does not want Lee coming any more and wants someone like Shelley.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he used to go to the bowls club but has not been since his hip.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he felt better for telling the assessor about the abuse.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated Lee slapped him across the face last Thursday because he was slow getting off the bed.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated Lee had also slapped him once before a few weeks back for being too slow.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated Lee grabbed his left arm to pull him up off the commode.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated Lee grabbed his left arm hard on Saturday.
Karen Walsh (S3) stated she saw bruises on Dennis Walsh's upper left arm when she helped him change his top on Sunday.
Karen Walsh (S3) described the bruises as four fingermarks in a row on the inside of his upper arm, purple in colour.
Karen Walsh (S3) stated she took photos of the bruises on her phone on Sunday.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he initially told Karen he had knocked the bruises, but later told her about Lee.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he did not want a fuss and did not want to lose the carers.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he had not told anyone at Brightpath about the abuse.
Dennis Walsh (S2) stated he would be okay with the police speaking to him if it stops Lee from doing it to someone else.
Karen Walsh (S3) stated Dennis Walsh gets the higher rate of Attendance Allowance.
Karen Walsh (S3) stated she does his shopping with his card and keeps the receipts.
